verdict.rationale: llamafile runs entirely offline with no cloud data sharing and no outbound networking (docs-2, docs-10, docs-15), which inherently limits data retention risk since nothing is transmitted to a vendor. However, there is no explicit documentation of in-app controls for deleting conversation history, logs, or cached data on the local machine — retention/deletion is left entirely to the user's own filesystem management rather than being a designed feature. Missing for 10: explicit deletion/retention controls or settings within the tool, documentation on where chat logs/history are stored locally, and any first-party statement framing this as a privacy control feature rather than a side-effect of local execution.
